entities.summary: Davud Monshizadeh was an Iranian Nazi politician, propagandist, and scholar of Iranian studies. He founded SUMKA and supported Nazism in Germany during World War II and in Iran after the war. He was a member of the SS and produced print and radio propaganda in Germany. He became a professor of Iranian languages for Uppsala University, Sweden, a position he held until his death.
